verdict.rationale: Figma's REST API lets you programmatically view and extract any objects, layers, and their properties from files, and folder endpoints support traversing projects, so a scripted bulk extraction is possible. Assets can be copied as SVG or bulk-exported via a plugin. However, community evidence notes that full-fidelity work stays locked in a proprietary format, and no local copy is kept unless you export repeatedly. missing for 10: a documented one-click full-account export, a full-fidelity file export in an open format, documented export formats for comments, prototypes and version history, and any vendor guidance on migrating off the platform.
